f7a77efce9d6b108f075d048f0885132df9d1ea5.summary: Analysis by Zyad Waleed Elzyat of the Auto-Color Linux backdoor, first documented by Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 in February 2025. Without root, the sample runs in the background, keeps state in a temporary directory and repeatedly tries to reach a remote server. As root, it installs an embedded 35,160-byte library and registers it in the preload configuration file, creating a user-space rootkit that hides the implant's files and filters network socket listings.
